display_long_description:
Solve the Crime. Find the Killer. Uncover the Truth — in VR.

Enter the world of "Who Is The Killer", a fully immersive VR murder mystery experience. Put on your headset and step into richly detailed environments where every shadow hides a clue, and every room could be the scene of the crime.

Your mission: identify the killer, the murder weapon, and the location of the crime before the other player guesses that.

🔍 Investigate
Explore multiple classic locations, including a lord's manor, an actor’s estate, and even a mysterious yacht at sea. Examine objects, analyze evidence, and connect the dots in true detective style.

🧠 Deduce
Use logic, observation, and intuition to uncover the truth. Which suspect had the motive? What weapon was used? Where did the murder happen? Only one combination is correct — will you figure it out?

🕵️ Immerse Yourself
This is more than just a game — it's a fully interactive VR crime scene investigation. Walk through realistic rooms, pick up objects, question suspects, and experience a true “whodunit” story like never before.

🎮 Features
• Classic Clue-style gameplay in immersive VR
• Multiple detailed crime scenes and atmospheric settings
• Interactive environments and intuitive controls
• Replayable cases with changing solutions
• Perfect for fans of escape rooms, detective games, and mystery puzzles

Whether you're a solo sleuth or playing with friends (coming soon), Who Is The Killer offers a mind-bending mystery experience.
